from.place: Proof decomposition: geometric factorisation and sheaf-theoretic acyclicity from the factorisation.

title: Acyclicity from a clopen factorisation witness
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and let p, r, k, i and J satisfy the hypotheses of lem-sp-proetale-open-injective-proper-acyclic. If w is an OpenProperClopenWitness p r k i, then for every q > 0 the q-th homology object of the ordinary constant-coefficient derived direct image of the degree-zero extension by zero of J along k is zero.

source.place: Clause (b), compactification independence; open-closed sequence, derived open restriction, local boundary cohomology, and proper direct image.

proof.text: Fix q>0. The open-restriction vanishing theorem proves that the higher direct image restricts to zero along i. The boundary-restriction theorem proves the same along its canonical closed complement. The ranges are complementary by the closed-complement range formula. Apply the existing ringed open-closed zero-detection theorem, with the canonical constant-coefficient comparison isomorphisms, to conclude that the homology object itself is zero.

proof_origin.description: F1: prove the open part by a clopen injective calculation and combine it with the isolated closed-boundary step using the recorded open-closed zero-detection theorem. The target statement is unchanged.

lean.statement: theorem isZero_higherDirectImage_open_injective_of_proper_of_witness (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {B D C E : Scheme.{u}} (p : B ⟶ D) (r : C ⟶ E) (k : C ⟶ B) (i : E ⟶ D) [IsProper p] [IsProper r] [IsOpenImmersion k] [QuasiCompact k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact i] (hcomm : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (J : proEtaleRingModules C (proEtaleConstantRing C A)) [Injective J] (w : OpenProperClopenWitness p r k i) : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (proEtaleRingModules D (proEtaleConstantRing D A)) (q : ℤ)).obj ((proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage p A).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (proEtaleRingModules B (proEtaleConstantRing B A)) 0).obj ((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero k A).obj J))))
